incidents.name: Alkemi Earn self-liquidation collateral inflation
incidents.notes: AlkemiEarn.liquidateBorrow() let a borrower liquidate their own position with the borrowed asset also serving as the collateral asset, crediting more supply than the repayment consumed, so a flash-loaned supply/borrow/self-liquidate/withdraw sequence walked out with more ETH than was deposited.

sources.ref: onchain review: AlkemiEarn proxy 0x4822D9172e5b76b9Db37B75f5552F9988F98a888 created 2021-09-07T18:41:12Z by 0x520da6e55eb070aa872cd08fe2665da44535cd33, not the attack-tx sender 0x0ed1c01b8420a965d7bd2374db02896464c91cd7; two EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 13685518 on 2021-11-25T20:14:20Z installing 0x85a948fd70b2b415bda93324581fb5fff1293df7, so the executing code was 1565.7 days old. 43.45 ETH x $2,055.46 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $89,310.
